model: Torchvision DeepLabV3 MobileNetV3 Large semantic guide
preprocessing: Antialiased triangle resize to 520x520; float sRGB, ImageNet mean/std.
output: Sum of selected class softmax probabilities; not an alpha matte.
training: Pretrained upstream on COCO with VOC labels; no Schist/private-photo fine-tuning.
compression: XZ preset 9; expanded ONNX is byte-identical.
